_comment: Each item is a question a reader would plausibly ask, the short answer, and
the source sentence quoted from the RAW extraction (not from the cleaned
output, so the set cannot be biased toward what the pipeline keeps).
A passage counts as retained only when the answer survives AND at least 60%
of the sentence's 5-word shingles survive, so a stray matching number
elsewhere cannot be counted as a kept answer.
